geometry_edits.rationale: Strengthen the dominant bar into a single continuous gesture that responds to the frontage rather than remaining purely rectilinear.
Use the long-axis bend to preserve continuity while giving the profile a clearer directional read.
Increase the carved void so the access edge becomes a legible public threshold rather than a shallow nick.

graph_edits.rationale: Introduce a subtle bend to turn the bar toward the frontage and strengthen the single dominant gesture across views.
Keep the bend aligned with the long bar so the mass remains coherent rather than fragmenting.
Deepen the ground void slightly so the frontage reads as a more public threshold and the court becomes more usable.

rationale: The candidate reads as one primary bar with a carved void and a coherent stepped/angled upper condition across all four views, so it clears the basic massing coherence gate. The dominant gesture is legible and the parcel response is credible: the mass occupies the field without collapsing into a generic box, and the blue frontage edge is answered by a visible ground-level void/cut rather than a sealed wall. That said, the section feels somewhat more sculptural than program-driven; the access/public threshold is present but not especially generous, and the stepped language risks reading as a formal effect more than an inhabitable section. Overall it is program-compatible for neighborhood living, but not yet fully resolved in section logic.
